title: Examplerputilspack
description:
an example of what rpputils implements
for resourcepacks that adds custom item properties into the game via resourcepacks
body: An example pack For [RppUtils](https://modrinth.com/mod/rpputils) this includes submerged property, hovered over property totem pop property crouching / sneaking property sprinting property on fire property and player slim / wide property
